edition: Unofficial Zork Cellar Recovery Locker Glulx

overrides.description: Add the Expedition B-gated physical two-object recovery locker and prepared seal behavior
Retain every qualified Release 1237 layer, load the recovery locker last, and assign Release 1238

player_outcomes: sealing Expedition B physically unlocks one bolted recovery locker in the Cellar
the player chooses at most two real objects with a combined size no greater than thirty
sealing the locker records the current canonical death count without copying any object
canonical death scatters only inventory still carried by the adventurer
physically returning to the Cellar and breaking the seal recovers exactly the protected kit
the seal may be broken early, making preparation reversible rather than a permanent trap
boundaries: no death hook or replacement death routine
no remote retrieval, inventory ledger, or duplicated item state
no universal stash network or cloud chest
no immunity for objects left on the player's body
no recursive audit or planning framework
